Etymology tree
Ancient Greek Μοῦσα (Moûsa)
Proto-Indo-European *-kos
Proto-Hellenic *-kos
Ancient Greek -κός (-kós)
Ancient Greek -ικός (-ikós)
Ancient Greek μουσικός (mousikós)
Latin mūsicusder.
Spanish músico
Derived from Latin mūsicus (“musician; pertaining to music”), from Ancient Greek μουσικός (mousikós, “musical”).
